lookalikes.text: Visual review confirms that 5movierulz.solutions and 5movierulz.ventures display the same dark MovieRulz header, navigation, orange panel and movie-poster grid. Their PNG SHA-256 hashes are identical and cosine is 1.000 (rounded). This establishes an exact captured duplicate, not common ownership.

embedding_failure.text: 0912sim.ir and adityanewsnetwork.com have cosine 0.915, but both captures show 403 Forbidden pages: similarity measures an error template, not intended website identity. Separately, CLIP labels the logo-only 000h555.com splash as for_sale although no sale offer is visible. The label set has no splash/loading class. These cases limit semantic conclusions from image vectors and their text-prompt scores.
